descricao_original: Several pseudounipolar neurons are seen in this image. Pseudounipolar neuron cell bodies vary in size, a feature that correlates with the type of sensory information each neuron conveys. Each cell body is surrounded by satellite Schwann cells which form a capsule. 750x
